scope: M1 through M5 and R1 through R4 browser E2E

tests.name: S1 reservation replay, fixed scope, no auth/CSRF and metadata bounds
S1 authorized immutable envelope, tampered expired wrong-purpose tickets and current login
S1 two PUTs and complete attach only once; uninspected ciphertext stays unavailable
S1 checksum failure closes old attempt, preserves orphan and creates fresh AAD
S1 interrupted stream reconciles after process restart without overwriting bytes
S1 durable manifest restores a lost stored commit; lost complete response keeps same ID
S1 concurrent organization quota allows ten reservations only, and storage refuses admission
S1 original reservation and authorization deadlines plus seven-day replay tombstone
S1 actual browser PDF XLSX encryption, draft restart and no plaintext network body
S1 full 10MiB ciphertext admission and route-only maximum size refusal
S1 lost browser PUT response resumes by receipt after reload, without another PUT
S1 retained ciphertext gets a fresh attempt after authorization window expires
S1 composite foreign keys reject cross-context reference injection

secrets_policy: No trace, video, storageState, network dump or failure screenshot. Diagnostics redact credentials and URLs.
